paper_excerpt: Twenty mice underwent acute treadmill running for 30 minutes. Gastrocnemius muscles were collected pre-exercise, immediately post-exercise, 1 hour post-exercise, and 24 hours post-exercise, with five animals at each time point. Oxford Nanopore long-read RNA sequencing was performed. TALON generated an abundance matrix. The data are deposited under GSE279359.
reasoning_demonstration: Inventory GSE279359 as mouse long-read RNA-seq and preserve each recovery time point.
Inspect the abundance matrix before choosing a DA method; raw integer counts may use count-aware methods, while FPKM/TPM or log-scale values require plain limma.
Keep reported splicing findings separate from newly computed DGE and pathway results.
safety_constraints: Do not copy GSE279359 into another study.
Do not pool biologically distinct time points.
Do not select a count model until integer-count compatibility is verified.
